confidence_notes: Numbeo's June 2026 Bangkok index provides typical meal, cappuccino and domestic draft-beer prices. Cocktail and wine prices vary substantially by venue, so those anchors are approximate. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates based on the supplied Thai city comparisons; no live booking prices were used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bangkok's capital-city demand supports slightly higher three-star and basic-room estimates than Chiang Mai and Ayutthaya. Hostel estimates remain near the supplied Phuket and Koh Lanta ranges.
